title: A bell that dies away
instruction: The pad on the Bell track rings on forever. Build an instrument (write the kernel) for the Bell track that is struck, not held: every note falls below -60 dBFS within 1.5 s of being played, even if the key is held, and still speaks (peaks above -30 dBFS, never over -1).

checks.label: Bell's instrument is one written in this song
Slowest note's time to fall below -60 dBFS (C3, C5 short; C4 held 2 s)
